dedupe_keys.name: 統計いしかき 水道およひ電気 electricity and power series on bodik odcs

description: 統計いしがき】水道および電気 [electricity and power] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 石垣市. 7-1. 水道の一日配水量、一人一日配水量及び普及率の推移 7-2. 水道の有収水量等の推移 7-3. 水道の用途別使用水量の推移 7-4. 水道の管総延長及び給水栓数等の推移 7-5. 電灯電力契約口数の推移 7-6. 電力需給状況の推移 7-7. 電灯 電力の使用量の推移. Coverage: 石垣市. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 石垣市. Its tags are 令和6年度統計いしがき. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
